g.text: ▲ TO ICELANDIC HIGH ELVES (GUNPOWDER & STEEL TRADE)
TO NORWEGIAN SPIRES & MOUNTAIN ELVEN COLONIES ▲
Spires extend south to Barcelona & north across Scandinavia)
THE THREE ISLE & NORTH SEA POWERS
Spire Placement (≥50-Mile Spacing Rule & Dutch Exception)
Capital: New Avalon (Edinburgh). Controls E. Scotland,
Orkney, NE England (York/Norwich) & Twin Dutch Spires.
Controls Ireland, Wales & Isle of Man. Full-scale mega-spires
socially identical to Arclean; spaced 65–110 miles apart.
Controls rest of England & N. France (~50 mi inland).
More numerous but smaller/less-populated Spires (≥55 mi apart).
Highlands & Beyond: Orcs, Free Folk, Dwarf Mines & Ruins
